title: LOVES KIZOMBA ORIGINS 2027 🌺🐝
description:
💛🌺 From March 19 to 22, 2027, LOVES KIZOMBA ORIGINS returns for its 3rd edition at Hotel Abades Benacazón, Seville, in an ALL IN ONE format.
4 days of workshops, parties, accommodation and meals — all in one place. No transfers. No wasted time. Just dance and connection.
This new edition brings many surprises, new emotions and unforgettable moments you won’t find at any other festival.
What’s included?
🎓 Workshops in Kizomba, Urban Kiz, Semba, Tarraxo, Douceur and Konpa
🎉 Themed night parties with national and international DJs
🏩 On-site accommodation (book using code ORIGINS at Hotel Abades Benacazón)
🍽️ Meals available on the premises
☀️ Swimming pool, gardens and socialising areas
💛 CHOOSE YOUR PASS:
💑 COUPLE PASS EARLY BIRD → best price for couples
🎟️ FULL PASS EARLY BIRD → secure your spot at the lowest price
⚠️ Limited spots. Once they’re gone, the price goes up.
👉🏽 https://salsero.es/…/loves-kizomba-origins-2027-3…
